name: agentmemory
description: Persistent cross-session memory for OpenClaw via agentmemory.

token_budget.label: Token Budget
token_budget.help: Approximate injected context budget (4 UTF-8 bytes per token); 0 disables recall

min_confidence.label: Min Confidence
min_confidence.help: Minimum normalized retrieval score, between 0 and 1

secret_env.label: Credential environment variable
secret_env.help: Name of an environment variable holding this endpoint credential. Setting it disables local credential-file fallback.
